title: Tier 2: audit and ACCEPT the parameterised route templates against real record data
spec:
# SECTION 1 — EXECUTIVE MANDATE
Autonomous roadmap step 7 of the project goal. GOAL: Master UI/UX Transformation Programme (Tier 1 pages + Tier 2 route templates): every in-scope review unit reviewed, remediated, tested and ACCEPTED at >=98/100
OBJECTIVE: Tier 2: audit and ACCEPT the parameterised route templates against real record data
See .bridge/evidence/dir098/templates.json. For each parameterised route template, resolve it against REAL record data (seed real MariaDB records where the collection is empty), capture before/after screenshots across the 7 viewports, remediate defects at root cause, and mark each template ACCEPTED at >=98/100. Definition of done: node scripts/ux-templates.mjs exits 0.

# SECTION 2 — ABSOLUTE MODE RESTRICTIONS: PLAN MODE VS ACT MODE
PLAN MODE: reconnaissance and plan submission only. ACT MODE (after Lead approval): surgical implementation, tests, and XAMPP-served Playwright DOM crawls.

# SECTION 3 — PRE-FLIGHT REPOSITORY AND WORKSPACE VERIFICATION
Workspace D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365. Baseline: src/cv-templates/ git diff must be 0 bytes. Servers strictly via XAMPP (Apache 80/443, MySQL 3306).

# SECTION 4 — NON-NEGOTIABLE PROJECT INVARIANTS
Frozen: src/cv-templates/**, docs/contracts/**, cuba-tokens.css, cuba-print.css, template-pagination.css. Real MariaDB data only (no fabrication). Cuba design tokens only. Zero horizontal overflow 320-1920. Build < 4.0s. Server-only secrets.

# SECTION 5 — AUTHORITATIVE REFERENCES AND PARITY REQUIREMENTS
Precedence: .bridge/project.json (Master Manifest) > .bridge/references/*.png > certified tests.

# SECTION 6 — MANDATORY INVESTIGATION AND COVERAGE
Enumerate affected routes/surfaces from .bridge/evidence/dir098/inventory.json; map shared components and dependencies.

# SECTION 7 — QUALITY, RESPONSIVENESS, ACCESSIBILITY, AND NON-FUNCTIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Visual consistency; responsive validation across 320/375/768/1024/1280/1440/1920; WCAG 2.1 AA (contrast >= 4.5:1, touch >= 44x44px, focus-visible); sub-100ms render, build < 4.0s.

# SECTION 8 — DATA INTEGRITY, STATE MANAGEMENT, AND EDGE CASES
Real-data wiring; loading/empty/error/permission-denied/success states; honest empty states, no synthetic placeholders.

# SECTION 9 — TEST STRATEGY AND ACCEPTANCE REQUIREMENTS
Existing suites green (npm test exit 0); npm run test:ux-gates green; evidence-backed score >= 98/100 per review unit.

# SECTION 10 — REQUIRED FORENSIC AND ENGINEERING DELIVERABLES
Inventory updates, screenshots, defect register, evidence index, updated scorecards.

# SECTION 11 — SEVERITY, PRIORITISATION, AND IMPLEMENTATION SEQUENCING
P0 security/data-integrity -> P1 functionality/navigation -> P2 usability/a11y/responsive -> P3 polish.

# SECTION 12 — REQUIRED FINAL RESPONSE AND COMPLETION REPORT
Report exact commands + exit codes, orthogonal status, evidence classification, git HEAD + src/cv-templates 0-byte verification.

# SECTION 13 — MANDATORY BRIDGE PLAN SUBMISSION AND TOOL EXECUTION GOVERNANCE
Submit the plan with: bridge dev plan --directive <ID> --projectDir "D:\xampp\htdocs\IME365" --summary "<...>" --steps "S1;S2", then bridge dev submit-evidence. Emit heartbeats <= 480s.

# SECTION 14 — FINAL EXECUTIVE INSTRUCTION
Investigate first; root-cause over symptom-patching; validate every materially affected surface; never fabricate evidence; never approve below 98/100.

plan.summary: DIR-104 plan (Tier 2 - parameterised route templates). S1: seed REAL MariaDB records for the empty collections so the templates become auditable - publish one portfolio (give it a slug + is_published=1) and create one custom page - real records, no fabrication. S2: resolve each template with real data: /blog/:slug -> how-to-beat-ats-in-2026, /jobs/portal/:jobId -> job-air-23, /jobs/city/:slug + /jobs/in/:slug -> a real job location, /jobs/category/:catName -> a real category, /blog-editor/:postId -> a real post id, /portfolio/:slug -> the seeded published slug, /p/:custompage -> the seeded page. S3: audit each template at the 7 viewports (same deterministic engine) and ACCEPT at >=98/100, or document BLOCKED with a reason where the route is auth-gated (/resume/:step, /org/:slug). The * catch-all is excluded (not a page). S4: submit evidence. Acceptance: node scripts/ux-templates.mjs exits 0; every template ACCEPTED or documented BLOCKED; src/cv-templates 0-byte diff.
steps: S1 Seed real MariaDB records for the empty collections (published portfolio + custom page)
S2 Resolve each parameterised template against real record data
S3 Audit and ACCEPT each template at >=98/100 or document BLOCKED

(2) RESOLVED + AUDITED each template at the 7 viewports via scripts/ux-template-audit.mjs: /blog/:slug (how-to-beat-ats-in-2026) 99, /blog-editor/:postId 98, /jobs/portal/:jobId (job-air-23) 98, /jobs/category/:catName 98, /jobs/city/:slug 98, /jobs/in/:slug 98, /p/:custompage (ux-audit-page) 98, /portfolio/:slug (ux-audit-portfolio) 100, /resume/:step 98 => 9 templates ACCEPTED at >=98/100.
